description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born quick-service burger chain known for 100% fresh Canadian beef burgers, hand-scooped milkshakes, and Kennebec fries. This Fort St. John location sits on Alaska Road South and offers a drive-through alongside takeout and delivery options. It is part of a chain with roots going back to the original White Spot restaurant founded in Vancouver in 1928.

address.value: 11127 Alaska Road South, Fort St. John, V1J 0P2
